t: The LAP Weyburn outdoor LED floodlight in white is a robust lighting solution designed for exterior applications. This powerful 20W LED floodlight delivers 2000 lumens of daylight white 5000K illumination, making it suitable for illuminating driveways, gardens, or commercial building perimeters. Its durable die-cast aluminium body and IP65 rating ensure reliable performance in all weather conditions. The integrated LED technology provides a long 30,000-hour lifespan, reducing maintenance. Installation is straightforward with the pre-wired 0.75m cable and supplied fixings, while the adjustable tilting head allows for precise light direction.
b: Includes 0.75m Pre-Wired Cable for Easy Installation
